llcFilesWith: Utah Division of Corporations and Commercial Code (DBA / assumed name registration)
soleProprietorFilesWith: Utah Division of Corporations and Commercial Code (the same DBA registration)
feeBasis: The Division of Corporations charges a flat $22 to register a DBA, the same amount for an LLC or a sole proprietor. Expedited processing is an extra $75.
renewalRule: Renewed every three years from the registration date (most Utah entities renew annually, but a DBA is a three-year cycle). Renewal costs $18, which the Division's fee schedule marks as including a $5 surcharge for the state's single sign-on portal, and a late renewal adds $10. A DBA name cannot be amended, so changing the name means a new filing, and an expired DBA cannot be reinstated.
protectionNote: Utah Code § 42-2-9(2)(b) provides that a filing under the chapter does not of itself authorize using an assumed name in violation of the rights of another under the chapter, the state Registration and Protection of Trademarks and Service Marks Act, entity-name law, the federal Trademark Act of 1946, or the common law, so registration grants no exclusive right. It does sit in the records the Division screens for distinguishability, so while active a DBA blocks a later entity or DBA name that is not distinguishable from it.
searchNote: DBAs are registered with the Division of Corporations and appear in the same business search as LLCs and corporations, since they share the distinguishability records.
statuteCitation: Utah Code Title 42, Chapter 2 (Conducting Business Under Assumed Name)
notes: Utah runs a clean state-level DBA: one $22 registration with the Division of Corporations, statewide, renewable every three years, with no county filing and no publication. Registration is a disclosure filing, not a grant of rights, but it does join the Division's distinguishability records. Utah has scheduled a restructure of Title 42, Chapter 2 effective 2026-10-01: the chapter is retitled Conducting Business As A D.B.A. and splits into two parts, with §§ 42-2-5 and 42-2-8 repealed and §§ 42-2-6.6, 42-2-7 and 42-2-9 renumbered, so the section citations here need re-checking after that date.
